# Change request 21 for the notes app

The app in this directory already implements the notes app. Everything it does today must keep working, with and
without JavaScript, unless this request changes it. Change the following.

## Note numbers
- Every note gets a number that identifies it among its owner's notes: `1` for the user's first note, `2` for the
  next, and so on. Each note's `<li>` on the list page shows the text `No. <number>`, for example `No. 3`.
- Notes that already exist get their numbers now, in the order of their `Added` moment, oldest first. The seeded
  notes are numbered:

| user | note | number |
|---|---|---|
| ada | `Call Bob` | 1 |
| ada | `Buy milk` | 2 |
| bob | `Bob's secret` | 1 |

- A note added later gets the number after the highest one its owner has ever had. A number is never reused:
  deleting a note (also with `Delete selected`) does not free its number.
- A note keeps its number when it is edited, pinned, archived, restored or brought back with `Undo`.
- Numbers are per user: one user's notes do not affect another user's numbers. After an account is deleted, the same
  name starts again at `1`.
- The numbers are stored on the server and shown with and without JavaScript.

  "name": "app",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "hozu dev",
    "check": "hozu check",
    "start": "hozu serve",
    "build": "hozu build"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@hozu/adapter-node": "^0.17.1",

    "@hozu/transform": "^0.17.1",
    "zod": "^4.6.5"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@hozu/dev": "^0.17.1",
    "@hozu/testing": "^0.17.1",
    "@types/node": "^22.20.4",
    "typescript": "^7.0.2"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22.18"
  }
}
import { project, ui } from '@hozu/core'
import { zodAdapter } from '@hozu/schema-zod'
import { accountDelete, admin, archive, home, login } from './routes.ts'
import { AdminBoard, AdminLink } from './features/admin/views.ts'
import { listUsers } from './features/admin/model.ts'
import { adminFeature } from './features/admin/feature.ts'
import { ArchiveBoard, NotesBoard, notesText } from './features/notes/views.ts'
import { notes } from './features/notes/feature.ts'
import { me, Session } from './features/account/model.ts'
import { AccountBar, accountText, DeleteAccountPage, Login } from './features/account/views.ts'
import { account } from './features/account/feature.ts'

export default project({
  schema: zodAdapter,
  session: Session,
  styles: new URL('./app.css', import.meta.url),
  app: new URL('./app.ts', import.meta.url),
  env: { files: ['.env', '.env.local'] },
  site: { url: 'http://localhost:3000', name: 'app', lang: 'en', locales: ['en', 'de'] },
  routes: { home, login, archive, admin, accountDelete },
  pages: [
    ui.page(login, { views: [Login], head: { render: () => ({ title: accountText.signIn }) } }),
    ui.page(home, {
      views: [AccountBar, AdminLink, NotesBoard],
      head: {
        query: me,
        input: () => ({}),
        render: () => ({ title: notesText.notes, noindex: true }),
        failed: { Unauthorized: login },
      },
    }),
    ui.page(archive, {
      views: [AccountBar, ArchiveBoard],
      head: {
        query: me,
        input: () => ({}),
        render: () => ({ title: 'Archive', noindex: true }),
        failed: { Unauthorized: login },
      },
    }),
    ui.page(accountDelete, {
      views: [DeleteAccountPage],
      head: {
        query: me,
        input: () => ({}),
        render: () => ({ title: 'Delete account', noindex: true }),
        failed: { Unauthorized: login },
      },
    }),
    ui.page(admin, {
      views: [AccountBar, AdminBoard],
      head: {
        query: listUsers,
        input: () => ({}),
        render: () => ({ title: 'Admin', noindex: true }),
        failed: { Unauthorized: login, NotAdmin: 403 },
      },
    })],
  features: [account, notes, adminFeature],
})
import { resolvers } from '@hozu/data'
import { app } from '@hozu/runtime-server'
import project from './hozu.config.ts'
import { createStore, notesResolvers, ownedCounts, type Deleted } from './features/notes/server.ts'
import { adminResolvers } from './features/admin/server.ts'
import { accountResolvers } from './features/account/server.ts'

// Undo of the last delete, per user; signing out forgets it.
const deleted: Deleted = new Map()
const store = createStore()
// Everyone who has signed in, for the admin page.
const seen = new Set<string>()

export default app({
  resolvers: resolvers(project, (implement) => [
    ...accountResolvers(
      implement,
      (user) => deleted.delete(user),
      (user) => seen.add(user),
      // Deleting an account drops the user's notes (shared ones vanish for their recipients) and forgets the user.
      (user) => {
        store.delete(user)
        deleted.delete(user)
        seen.delete(user)
      },
    ),
    ...notesResolvers(implement, deleted, store),
    ...adminResolvers(implement, () => ownedCounts(store), seen),
  ]),
})

import { contract, part, ui } from '@hozu/core'
import { accountDelete, archive, home } from '../../routes.ts'
import {
  Add,
  Archive,
  archiveNotes,
  Bulk,
  removeNotes,
  Select,
  listArchived,
  Restore,
  addedOn,
  exportNotes,
  CancelEdit,
  Edit,
  Save,
  Draft,
  listNotes,
  matching,
  firstMatching,
  countMatching,
  noneMatch,
  notesMachine,
  Pin,
  Remove,
  Search,
  Undo,
  lastDeleted,
  listShared,
  Share,
  Unshare,
  DUPLICATE,
} from './model.ts'

export const notesText = ui.messages('en', {
  en: { notes: 'Notes', count: 'Notes: {count}', title: 'Title', add: 'Add', delete: 'Delete', search: 'Search', duplicate: 'You already have a note with this title' },
  de: { notes: 'Notizen', count: 'Notizen: {count}', title: 'Titel', add: 'Hinzufügen', delete: 'Löschen', search: 'Suche', duplicate: 'Du hast bereits eine Notiz mit diesem Titel' },
})

// The note being added, shown first until the server accepts it.
const pendingNote = part((title: string) =>
  ui.li({ class: 'flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 opacity-50', 'aria-busy': 'true' }, [
    ui.span({ class: 'flex-1' }, [title]),
    ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-slate-500' }, ['saving']),
  ]),
)

// The bulk buttons; each note's checkbox joins this form.
const bulk = ui.formRef()

export const NotesBoard = ui.view({
  machine: notesMachine,
  route: home,
  seed: ({ search }) => ({ q: search.q }),
  render: ({ ctx, when, search, locale }) =>
    ui.main({ class: 'mx-auto max-w-xl space-y-6 px-4 py-12' }, [
      ui.h1({ class: 'text-3xl font-bold' }, [notesText.notes]),
      ui.nav({ class: 'flex gap-4 text-sm' }, [
        ui.a({ href: locale === 'en' ? ui.alternate('de') : ui.alternate('en'), class: 'underline' }, [locale === 'en' ? 'Deutsch' : 'English']),
        ui.a({ href: ui.link(archive, null), class: 'underline' }, ['Archived notes']),
        ui.a({ href: ui.link(accountDelete, null), class: 'underline' }, ['Delete account']),
        ui.a({ href: ui.link(exportNotes, {}), class: 'underline' }, ['Export']),
      ]),
      ui.form({ class: 'flex gap-2', on: { submit: ui.send(Add, { title: ui.dom.form('title') }) } }, [
        ui.label({ for: 'notes-title', class: 'sr-only' }, [notesText.title]),
        ui.input({
          id: 'notes-title',
          name: 'title',
          required: true,
          maxlength: 60,
          placeholder: notesText.title,
          value: ctx.draft,
          'aria-invalid': ctx.fields.title !== null,
          'aria-describedby': 'notes-title-error',
          class: 'flex-1 rounded border px-3 py-2',
          on: { input: ui.send(Draft, { title: ui.dom.value }) },
        }),
        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'rounded bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-white' }, [notesText.add]),
      ]),
      ui.p({ id: 'notes-title-error', role: 'alert', class: 'text-sm text-rose-600' }, [ctx.fields.title]),
      ctx.error !== null && ui.p({ role: 'alert', class: 'text-rose-600' }, [ctx.error === DUPLICATE ? notesText.duplicate : ctx.error]),
      ui.query(
        lastDeleted,
        {},
        {
          ready: (deleted) =>
            deleted === null
              ? null
              : ui.div({ role: 'status', class: 'flex items-center gap-3 rounded bg-slate-100 px-4 py-2 text-sm' }, [
                ui.span({ class: 'flex-1' }, [`Deleted "${deleted.title}"`]),
                ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Undo, { id: ui.dom.form('id') }) } }, [
                  ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: deleted.id }),
                  ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'underline' }, ['Undo']),
                ]),
              ]),
          failed: { Unauthorized: () => null, Unexpected: () => null },
        },
      ),
      ui.query(
        listNotes,
        {},
        {
          ready: (items) => ui.div({ class: 'space-y-3' }, [
            ui.p({ class: 'text-sm text-slate-600' }, [notesText.count({ count: items.length })]),
            ui.form({ method: 'get', class: 'flex gap-2' }, [
              ui.input({
                type: 'search',
                name: 'q',
                'aria-label': notesText.search,
                placeholder: notesText.search,
                value: ctx.q,
                class: 'flex-1 rounded border px-3 py-2',
                on: { input: ui.send(Search, { q: ui.dom.value }) },
              }),
              ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'rounded border px-4 py-2' }, [notesText.search]),
            ]),
            ui.p({ class: 'text-sm text-slate-600' }, [
              `Showing ${matching({ items: firstMatching({ items, q: search.q, limit: search.limit }), q: ctx.q }).length} of ${countMatching({ items, q: search.q })}`,
            ]),
            ui.form({ ref: bulk, 'aria-label': 'Bulk actions', class: 'flex items-center gap-3 text-sm', on: { submit: ui.send(Bulk, { ids: ui.dom.formAll('ids'), action: ui.dom.form('action') }) } }, [
              ui.span({ class: 'flex-1 text-slate-600' }, [`Selected: ${ctx.selected.length}`]),
              ui.button({ type: 'submit', name: 'action', value: 'delete', class: 'rounded border px-3 py-1' }, ['Delete selected']),
              ui.button({ type: 'submit', name: 'action', value: 'archive', class: 'rounded border px-3 py-1' }, ['Archive selected']),
            ]),
            noneMatch({ items: firstMatching({ items, q: search.q, limit: search.limit }), q: ctx.q })
              ? [
                when(['adding'], [ui.ul({ class: 'divide-y rounded border bg-white' }, [pendingNote(ctx.draft)])]),
                ui.p({ class: 'text-slate-500' }, ['No notes match']),
              ]
              : ui.ul({ class: 'divide-y rounded border bg-white' }, [
                when(['adding'], [pendingNote(ctx.draft)]),
                ui.each(matching({ items: firstMatching({ items, q: search.q, limit: search.limit }), q: ctx.q }), 'id', (item) =>
                  ui.li({ class: 'flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3' }, [
                    ui.input({
                      type: 'checkbox',
                      form: bulk,
                      name: 'ids',
                      value: item.id,
                      'aria-label': `Select ${item.title}`,
                      checked: ctx.selected.includes(item.id),

content.text:
## 摘要

每則筆記現在都有一個編號，在清單頁上顯示為 `No. <number>`。有無 JavaScript 都會顯示，且已實際測試過。

**修改內容**
- **資料格式**（`features/notes/model.ts`）：每則筆記新增 `number` 欄位。
- **伺服器**（`features/notes/server.ts`）：
  - 每位使用者各有一個「曾用過的最大編號」紀錄，新增筆記時取「最大值 + 1」。
  - 刪除筆記（包括「Delete selected」）不會讓這個紀錄倒退，所以編號不會被重複使用。
  - 編輯、置頂、封存、還原、Undo 都不會改動編號。
  - 既有的種子筆記依新增時間編號：ada 的 `Call Bob` 是 1、`Buy milk` 是 2，bob 的 `Bob's secret` 是 1。
- **`app.ts`**：刪除帳號時一併清掉該使用者的編號紀錄，同名使用者重新註冊後從 1 開始。
- **畫面**（`features/notes/views.ts`）：每則筆記的 `<li>` 裡加上 `No. <number>`。

**驗證結果**
- **`npx hozu check`**：0 個錯誤，6/6 個合約通過，lock 不需更新。剩下的 6 個 HZ090 警告是這次修改前就有的，與本次無關。
- **用 `hozu browse --js both` 實測（有無 JS 結果一致，沒有錯誤）：**
  - ada 新增 `Third` 得到 No. 3；刪掉它之後再新增 `Fourth`，得到 No. 4。
  - 進入編輯模式不影響編號。
  - bob 新增筆記得到 No. 2。
  - ada 刪除帳號、重新登入後，新增的筆記從 No. 1 開始。
- **正式伺服器**：用 `PORT=4813 npm start` 啟動，`/login` 回應 200；測試完已依 PID 停止。

**已知限制**
- 編號紀錄和現有的筆記資料一樣只存在記憶體中，伺服器重啟後會回到種子資料的狀態。這和 app 原本的行為一致。

## 下一步建議
1. **要求登入才能讀取**：處理那 6 個 HZ090 警告，把使用者資料查詢的 `access: 'anyone'` 改成 `'signedIn'`，免得未登入的訪客也能呼叫。
2. **改用持久化儲存**：如果這個 app 要長期使用，把筆記和編號紀錄改存到資料庫，重啟後才不會遺失。
3. **其他地方也顯示編號**：看是否要在封存頁或匯出（`/api/export`）中加上編號，讓使用者在各處都能對照同一則筆記。

## 下一步建議
1. **要求登入才能讀取**：處理那 6 個 HZ090 警告，把使用者資料查詢的 `access: 'anyone'` 改成 `'signedIn'`，免得未登入的訪客也能呼叫。
2. **改用持久化儲存**：如果這個 app 要長期使用，把筆記和編號紀錄改存到資料庫，重啟後才不會遺失。
3. **其他地方也顯示編號**：看是否要在封存頁或匯出（`/api/export`）中加上編號，讓使用者在各處都能對照同一則筆記。
